name: Terrarium 45x35x35
label: Medium terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 45x35x35 cm. Volume: 55.1 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: The 45x35x35 cm terrarium has 1575 cm² of floor and about 55 liters. Without a 3D background all 35 cm of depth is left for the animal. The format is horizontal, but at 35 cm high it is not low, so it can be set up both for ground species and for climbers.

For a single adult leopard gecko this area is enough for three hides and open space to move around. For a crested gecko, place branches up to the top, because it will use all 35 cm. Day geckos need a lamp at one end and a dense plant at the other. A young corn snake can grow here for its first year.

The model five centimeters longer with the same width and height is the 50x35x35, with or without a 3D background. If you need a taller version of this floor, the 45x35x80 is in our range. We cover the back and sides with film from our range of 34 patterns. For a different length or height we need 7 to 14 days.
